title: Dawnice Residential Hybrid Inverter
summary: Single-phase and split-phase hybrid inverter family for solar battery charging, backup, and residential energy management.

faqs.question: What is split-phase and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: Split-phase 120/240 V is the standard North American service: 120 V for outlets and lighting, 240 V for dryers, water heaters, EV chargers, and central AC. A single-phase 230 V model cannot deliver that.

faqs.question: Does it work off-grid or grid-tied?
faqs.answer: Both. Off-grid models suit sites with no utility supply; hybrid models run grid-tied for self-consumption and keep a backup output live.

faqs.question: Which batteries can it pair with?
faqs.answer: Low-voltage packs, model dependent. Send the battery datasheet and BMS protocol and we confirm the pairing before quotation.
